description: Create or update a variable. Feature tools can then reference it by name (depth_variable, radius_variable, ...) so a dimension lives in one place. Uses the variable table where the account supports it and falls back to an assignVariable feature otherwise; result.route says which was used. On the feature route an existing variable of the same name is rewritten in place, so features built after it pick up the new value (result.action is updated or created).

elem.description: Element id (tab) — the <elem> segment of the document URL.

expression.description: Value expression with units, e.g. "0.25 in" or "2 * #wall".

type.description: Variable type; inferred from the expression's units when omitted.

ws.description: Workspace id — the <ws> segment of the document URL.

name: onshape_set_variable
title: Set a Part Studio variable
